{{Recipe}}

Try this recipe for a festive Friday night meal.
==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] / 900 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) medium [[Cookbook:Eggplant|eggplants]]
* ¼ lb (113 g) button [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* ½ lb (225 g) [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 cup (240 ml) chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
* 4 large cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] or to taste
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]] to taste
* 2 tsp extra virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ⅔ cup (80 g) [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]]
* 3 heaping [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Caper|capers]], drained
* 1 can (6 oz / 170 g) [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* 2–3 small [[Cookbook: Tomato|tomatoes]], sliced

==Procedure==
# Cut eggplants in half lengthwise, leaving a ¼-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (0.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) rind.
# Scoop out flesh using a curved serrated grapefruit knife, and coarsely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chop]] it. 
# Place chopped eggplant into a large, deep [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] or flat-bottomed [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]].
# Rub inside of eggplant shells with olive oil and set aside on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]]. 
# Add mushrooms, tomatoes, onions, garlic, salt, cinnamon, pepper, and olive oil to skillet, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] 5 to 10 minutes until soft but still chunky.
# Place eggplant shells under the [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]], and broil 3 inches (7.5 cm) from heat source for 8–12 minutes, until fork tender (be careful not to burn). 
# Remove from heat source and set aside.
# Coarsely grind walnuts, add to skillet along with capers and tomato paste, and mix well.
# Fill eggplant shells with sautéed mixture and top with tomato slices. 
# Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] uncovered at 375°F for 25–35 minutes.
